slides.title: Why bad habits win when you're tired
slides.sub: Every bad habit started as a choice. Repeat it enough and it starts choosing for you.

slides.title: The habit loop
items: Cue: stress, boredom, a time, a place
slides.note: Willpower and decisions draw on the same limited tank. Tired = low tank.

slides.title: Add friction
slides.body: Make the bad routine harder to reach. Delete the app. Move the trigger out of sight.

slides.title: Same cue, new routine
slides.body: If stress is the cue, decide ahead of time what you'll do instead, so something better fires first.

slides.title: Plan for low moments
slides.body: Change your surroundings and decide your response to fatigue before you're tired. A reminder is a cue you place on purpose.

slides.title: Change the loop, not your willpower.
slides.body: The full breakdown is on the blog at singles-life.app
